description:
Brand Introduction:

Welcome to Scrunchied & Co., where creativity meets quality. We specialize in high-quality custom apparel and handsewn accessories designed for every member of the family. Our collection is a celebration of individuality, offering unique, limited-edition pieces that stand out from the crowd. At Scrunchied & Co., we believe that fashion should be as unique as you are, and our carefully curated selection reflects this philosophy.

Product Description:

At Scrunchied & Co., we offer a diverse range of custom apparel and handsewn accessories that cater to every style and personality. Our products include everything from bespoke scrunchies and handcrafted one-of-a-kind clothing items. Each piece is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring not only exceptional quality but also a touch of personal flair. Our limited-edition items are perfect for those looking to make a statement and express their individuality.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Our Unique Selling Point lies in the combination of high-quality craftsmanship and exclusive designs. Every product at Scrunchied & Co. is a limited edition, making each item a unique statement piece. Our commitment to custom, handsewn creations ensures that our customers receive products that are not only stylish but also crafted with care and precision. This focus on individuality and quality sets us apart from mass-produced fashion, offering a personalized touch that resonates with our creative clientele.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates will earn a 15% commission on every sale made through their referral links.
  • Payment Schedule: Payments are processed monthly, and affiliates will receive their earnings via PayPal.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: Affiliates must reach a minimum payout threshold of $5 before payments are issued.
  • Tracking and Reporting: Affiliates will have access to a dedicated dashboard where they can track their performance, view sales, and monitor earnings in real-time.

Other Information:

  • Affiliate Tools: We provide our affiliates with a range of marketing tools, including banners, product images, and promotional content to help them effectively promote our products.
  • Support: Our affiliate support team is available to assist with any questions or issues. We are committed to ensuring our affiliates have all the resources they need to succeed.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates will receive early access to new collections, special promotions, and exclusive discounts to share with their audience.
  • Program Terms: Affiliates must adhere to our program’s terms and conditions, which include guidelines on ethical marketing practices and proper use of promotional materials.

Thank you for considering partnering with Scrunchied & Co. We look forward to working with you to share our unique creations with a wider audience!
